prompt:
A full-body vertical 2:3 (1024×1536) character card image of an adult woman — the personification of the element Aluminium (알루미늄) itself — the sovereign of the Aluminium Nation. A female character who IS the element; her costume, ornaments and colors carry the element’s traits. Both hands are ordinary human hands and hold nothing.

1. STYLE
A Japanese anime key visual with a painterly finish: an anime-style character with an elegant adult anime face, large expressive eyes, a small nose and mouth, fine coloured linework and soft cel-to-painted shading with painted highlights in the hair and fabric. Behind her, a richly painted background with layered painterly colour, subtle visible brushwork, atmospheric perspective and cinematic depth. Luminous, rich colours; crisp focal details on the face and costume, softer painted edges toward the distance.
Face proportions: a short midface and a soft, gently rounded jawline with a small soft chin; any crown or headpiece sits above her hairline. Her eyes keep the shape and size described below.

2. CHARACTER
Age: about twenty — a fresh young-adult face; no facial lines.
Face — her own: a cheerful, sunny openness; fair skin; oval face; large eyes — large round eyes, level outer eye corners; soft rounded brows; small button nose; a wide mouth with softly upturned corners; sapphire-blue eyes; rosy flushed cheeks.
Body and hair: athletic build; a long ponytail with choppy uneven bangs; bright satin aluminium-silver hair with soft anodized pastel blue and rose tints.
Expression: a natural laugh, eyes crinkled, mouth open in a smile.
Her element, carried in her design: aluminium: a bright satin-silver metal so light it almost floats, the most common metal in the Earth's crust yet locked so tightly in clay and rust-red bauxite that it was once rarer than gold, laid only before an emperor's honoured guests, until electricity set it free; it shields itself in an invisible oxide skin that can be dyed soft anodized pastel colours; the skeleton of airships and aircraft, the humble can and kitchen foil of everyone; ruby and sapphire are nothing but coloured aluminium oxide; light, bright, cheerful and unpretentious.
Anatomy: one head, two arms and two legs, each joined at its natural joint; natural hands with five fingers.

3. COSTUME — MECHA
Costume: she is a female mecha personification — plates, joints, binders and glow lines carry the traits above; the plates must read as solid armor with visible joints, not as cloth or a gown; a back unit may carry the motif. Featherweight satin-silver aluminium armor built on a visible honeycomb lattice, plates anodized in soft pastel blue and rose gradients, a thin glassy oxide sheen on every edge, sapphire-blue sensor lenses, swept wing-like vanes on the back like an aircraft's control surfaces; light, bright and buoyant; the plates must read as solid armor, not a gown.
Silhouette: ring-shaped armor bands floating free around her waist and ankles, with light body armor — the floating rings make the shape. Only the overall shape is fixed; design the details freely in the element's materials and palette.
Colours: bright satin aluminium silver, soft anodized pastel blue and rose, bauxite clay red, a clear sapphire-blue accent.
Exposure (bold): her mecha frame is cut open by design in only these places — bare shoulders and upper arms between pauldron and gauntlet, and a deep open chest window with natural cleavage framed by the chest plates; everywhere else she stays fully plated. The plates stay on, fitted and symmetrical, with skin clearly showing in each opening. Nothing slipped off. Intimate areas covered; keep the plate material and palette.

4. SCENE
World: year 2200, an orbital shipyard of featherweight flyers: honeycomb aluminium airframes riveted together in open bays, hull plates anodized in soft pastel blues and roses, vast mirror-thin aluminized solar sails unfurling against a bright blue planet.
Pose: standing confidently, her body turned slightly while her face looks toward the viewer.
Light: the scene's own light, rendered the way this style renders light and skin.
Composition: vertical 2:3 full-body framing with modest headroom and clear space below the boots — the whole figure from the top of her head or headpiece to both feet stays inside the frame, occupying about four-fifths of the image height, with the same camera distance in every world; her hands stay inside the frame. Camera level with her face with natural portrait perspective; her head level, chin neither raised nor tucked — no upward perspective on her face, no wide-angle distortion, no low angle, no close crop.

5. CONSTRAINTS
One figure only; no text or numbers except her element's own chemical symbol (Al) and atomic number (13) — and those only as part of the scene: engraved, embroidered or glowing on her costume, a banner, a sign or a machine, never as a floating label, corner badge, periodic-table tile, caption or overlay on the picture; no logo or watermark.
Avoid: flat single-tone cel shading, photographic appearance, semi-realistic face, plastic 3D-render finish.
